table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
library(survey)
cat(sprintf('n_tables=%.16g\n', 1))
df$.ones <- 1
design <- svydesign(ids=~1, weights=~.ones, data=df)
# On-screen column letters, reproduced here so the script matches the table.
# Test: complex-samples t of weighted proportions (Q Automatic Taylor SE).
# var = sum(w^2 * resid^2) / (sum w)^2 * n/(n-1), binary outcome.
# Two-sample SE is sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2). Overlap is excluded: a respondent
# who sits in both columns is in neither side. df = n1 + n2 - 2.
# This is not survey::svyttest (that is a regression t with df = n - p).
# Benjamini-Hochberg covers column pairs, then each column versus the
# complement of the total, stub by stub, in that order. A letter is written
# only for a column pair with adjusted p < 0.05. The letter is the right
# column's slot. Uppercase when adjusted p <= 0.001, otherwise lowercase.
banner_letters <- function(design, stub, banner) {
  vars <- design$variables
  w <- as.numeric(weights(design))
  banner_char <- as.character(vars[[banner]])
  stub_char <- as.character(vars[[stub]])
  blevels <- unique(banner_char)
  slevels <- unique(stub_char)
  slots <- setNames(LETTERS[seq_along(blevels)], blevels)
  taylor_prop <- function(y, ww) {
    ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(ww) & ww > 0
    y <- y[ok]
    ww <- ww[ok]
    n <- length(y)
    if (n < 2) return(list(p=NA_real_, se=NA_real_, n=n))
    sw <- sum(ww)
    mean <- sum(ww * y) / sw
    resid <- y - mean
    var_t <- (sum((ww^2) * (resid^2)) / (sw * sw)) * (n / (n - 1))
    list(p=mean, se=sqrt(var_t), n=n)
  }
  pair_p <- function(y, left_idx, right_idx) {
    both <- left_idx & right_idx
    a <- taylor_prop(y[left_idx & !both], w[left_idx & !both])
    b <- taylor_prop(y[right_idx & !both], w[right_idx & !both])
    se <- sqrt(a$se^2 + b$se^2)
    if (!is.finite(se) || se <= 0 || a$n < 2 || b$n < 2) return(1)
    tstat <- (a$p - b$p) / se
    df <- a$n + b$n - 2
    2 * stats::pt(-abs(tstat), df=max(df, 1))
  }
  raw <- numeric(0)
  meta <- list()
  for (s in slevels) {
    y <- as.numeric(stub_char == s)
    pair_n <- 0
    for (i in seq_along(blevels)) {
      for (j in seq_along(blevels)) {
        if (j <= i) next
        p <- pair_p(y, banner_char == blevels[i], banner_char == blevels[j])
        raw <- c(raw, p)
        meta[[length(meta) + 1]] <- list(stub=s, left=blevels[i], right=blevels[j], pair=TRUE, p=p)
        pair_n <- pair_n + 1
      }
    }
    for (i in seq_along(blevels)) {
      p <- pair_p(y, banner_char == blevels[i], banner_char != blevels[i] & !is.na(banner_char))
      raw <- c(raw, p)
      meta[[length(meta) + 1]] <- list(stub=s, left=blevels[i], right="total", pair=FALSE, p=p)
    }
  }
  adjusted <- if (length(raw)) p.adjust(raw, method="BH") else numeric(0)
  shown <- character(0)
  if (length(adjusted)) {
    for (k in seq_along(adjusted)) {
      if (!isTRUE(meta[[k]]$pair)) next
      if (is.na(adjusted[k]) || adjusted[k] >= 0.05) next
      slot <- slots[[meta[[k]]$right]]
      if (adjusted[k] > 0.001) slot <- tolower(slot)
      shown <- c(shown, paste(meta[[k]]$stub, meta[[k]]$left, slot, sep="|"))
    }
  }
  list(p=raw, adjusted=as.numeric(adjusted), letters=shown)
}
got <- banner_letters(design, "brand", "gender")
cat(sprintf('n_letters=%.16g\n', length(got$letters)))
cat(sprintf('p1=%.16g\n', if (length(got$p)) got$p[1] else 1))
